description: On a country show field in golden afternoon light, a young woman in an olive tank top, tan work trousers, boots and work gloves kneels on the grass and pushes a huge orange pumpkin onto a wooden pallet next to a much smaller pumpkin. Then she stands up, steps back and smiles at it, surprised and proud. Older people stand behind a rope watching, next to a chalkboard with a list. A striped marquee, a table of smaller pumpkins and a wheelbarrow fill the background.

taps.phrase: to tower over a small pumpkin
